subject: FrostBank security priority map + asks from discovery call
messages:
From: Maya Srinivasan <maya.s@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@frostbank.com>, Tom Leonard <tom.leonard@frostbank.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.c@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: FrostBank discovery — security priorities + immediate asks
Attachments: FrostBank_SOC2_questions_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet; 32KB)

Hi Aisha / Tom —

Thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap from our end and a short list of asks so your security and procurement teams can see what we discussed and what would unblock an initial evaluation. If you prefer, we can convert this into a mutual action plan in HubSpot (I can own the milestones).

Top pain points you shared:
- Regulatory audit readiness: auditors require 12+ months of immutable audit logs and retention controls.
- Data residency & DPA language: legal needs stronger guarantees around data scope and subprocessors.
- Pen test evidence: your security team needs prior pen test summary and remediation timelines before production onboarding.
- Access / auth model: you operate SSO / SAML and need proof of MFA enforcement and role mapping for API keys.

Goals we aligned on:
1) Confirm security acceptance criteria for pilot by 2028-07-15
2) Receive SOC 2 evidence package and audit-log retention SLA by 2028-07-01
3) Small pilot (non-PII workload) on Dedicated capacity for 4 weeks after acceptance

Immediate asks (please):
- Attach: I included a short SOC 2 intake spreadsheet (attached) with specific artifact asks we can fill from our side. Please mark which items you can accept vs items you need Redwood to provide.
- DPA: would you like us to send our standard DPA or would you prefer to share your redline? If you send the redline, we can route to legal + security for a 72-hour turnaround.
- Pen test / 3rd-party attestations: Do you need the full pen-test report or will a summary + remediation tracker suffice for initial procurement?
- Audit-log retention: you indicated a 13-month immutable retention requirement — can you confirm the exact retention window and whether export/chain-of-custody proofs are required?

Proposed next steps / owners:
- Maya (me): will share an access checklist and a short checklist of configuration requirements for a Dedicated pilot by EOD today.
- Ben: will provide an initial cost estimate and pilot sizing options for Dedicated capacity by Thurs (2028-06-22).
- FrostBank (Aisha): confirm retention window and indicate whether legal will share a DPA redline.

If helpful, we can set a 30-minute follow-up with your security lead + our Head of Security to walk through evidence artifacts and acceptable substitutes (e.g., remediated pen test + SOC2 bridge letter).

Thanks again — speak soon.

—
Maya Srinivasan
Senior Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.c@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maya Srinivasan <maya.s@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.p@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: RE: FrostBank discovery — security priorities + immediate asks

Adding a few internal notes and proposed approach before we loop legal:

Maya — good write-up. Notes:
- Cost / sizing: FrostBank sized the pilot as small throughput but strict retention; we should propose a Dedicated pool with WAF + private networking enabled. I'll produce two options: (A) 1x A100-equivalent reserved, (B) 2x smaller GPUs with autoscaling for cost optimization.
- SOC2 artifacts: I recommend we pre-package a SOC2 summary + control matrix and a redacted pen-test summary. For the full pen-test report, we can request an NDA from FrostBank before sharing complete details.
- DPA turn: if they send a redline, legal needs the doc in DocX and a summary of major clauses (data scope, subprocessors, retention, deletion, audit rights). We can aim for 72 business hours once we have the redline.
- Audit logs: implement an exportable WORM (write-once) S3 bucket with signed manifests; security can provide chain-of-custody by hashing exports and storing manifests with timestamps. Is that something Olga can own to document?

Olga — can you prepare a one-page artifact map (SOC2 controls -> Redwood artifacts) and a sample export manifest template by EOD Wed (2028-06-21)? That will speed things. Also confirm whether we can supply the pen-test summary redaction template for compliance.

I will draft a short MAPl (mutual action plan) and attach an initial pricing sketch.

—Ben

ben.c@redwoodinference.com

Maya — thanks for the clear summary and Ben/Olga for the internal plan. A few answers and confirmations from our side: 

1) DPA: we'll send a redline by Thurs (2028-06-22). Legal prefers to redline your DPA rather than receive your standard template. Expect that PDF to arrive via DocuSign with comments.
2) SOC2 / pen test: for initial procurement our audit team will accept a SOC2 Type II summary plus a redacted pen-test and remediation tracker. For full production onboarding we will require the complete pen-test under NDA.
3) Retention & exports: confirmed — 13 months immutable. We require verifiable export hashes for audit review.
4) Pilot: we can proceed with a non-PII pilot once the DPA redline is in and we have the artifact map. Proposed pilot start window: week of 2028-07-08.

Attachments: security-portal-access.txt (instructions for our SecPortal), procurement-contacts.vcf (Tom)

I will add the procurement and security reviewers to the HubSpot MAPl once we receive the initial pricing. Also sharing a link to our security portal with requested evidence checklist: https://security-portal.frostbank.com/shared/secure/record/9482

Thanks —
